<div id="text-text-e54d105959" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>Official Product Name</h4>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3"><a href="https://www.avast.com/free-antivirus-download">Avast Free Antivirus</a>, <a href="https://www.avast.com/internet-security">Avast Internet Security</a>, <a href="https://www.avast.com/premium-security">Avast Premium Security</a>, <a href="https://www.avast.com/premier">Avast Premier</a>, Avast Pro Antivirus, Avast Security Pro, <a href="https://www.avast.com/free-mac-security">Avast Security for Mac</a>, <a href="https://www.avast.com/premium-security">Avast Premium Security for Mac</a></p>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3"><a href="https://www.avast.com/business/products/business-antivirus">Avast Business Antivirus</a><span style="">, </span><a href="https://www.avast.com/business/products/business-antivirus-pro">Avast Business Antivirus Pro</a><span style="">, </span><a href="https://www.avast.com/business/products/business-antivirus-pro-plus">Avast Business Antivirus Pro Plus</a><span style="">, </span><a href="https://www.avast.com/business/services/patch-management">Avast Business Patch Management</a><span style="">, </span><a href="https://www.avast.com/business/business-hub">Avast Business Hub</a><span style="">, </span><a href="https://www.avast.com/business/products/standalone-antivirus">Avast Business Antivirus for Mac</a><span style="">, </span><a href="https://www.avast.com/business/products/antivirus-for-linux">Avast Business Antivirus for Linux</a><span style="">, </span><a href="https://www.avast.com/business/products/small-business">Essential Business Security</a><span style="">, </span><a href="https://www.avast.com/business/products/small-business">Premium Business Security</a><span style="">, </span><a href="https://www.avast.com/business/products/small-business">Ultimate Business Security</a><span style="">, </span><a href="https://www.avast.com/business/products/small-business">Small Office Protection</a><br />
</p>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">(collectively as “Antivirus for Desktop”)</p>

<div id="text-text-60bdf40216" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>Core Functionality</h4>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">The Antivirus for Desktop provides protection against malicious, harmful or unwanted software and technologies as well as detection for advanced scams. It may also detect other threats to your online privacy and inform about possible protections against these risks.</p>
 
</div>

<div id="spacer-d4ad7ed08c" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>

<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-559537b02f" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>What are Product’s Main Features</h4>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Smart Scan</b> is a comprehensive scan that helps detects browser threats, outdated applications, hidden viruses, system issues, online privacy threats and other issues depending on the provided features.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Protection features</b> provide core defenses for blocking malware and other threats including protection against malicious files, QR codes, suspicious applications, web attacks and unsafe downloads, unauthorized remote access attempts or dangerous email attachments. To do this, we scan files, programs, applications, attachments, URLs or other sources for potential threats. Sometimes, we may directly analyze suspicious files in our safe environment to make sure you are protected.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Network inspector</b> scans for vulnerabilities and potential security issues in your network (including for example router and connected devices).</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Firewall</b> helps control what data goes in and out of your computer to block traffic from malicious sources and prevent unauthorized access to your device.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Scam Guardian</b> features help block potentially dangerous websites and analyze texts, emails, messages or other media to avoid scams. It can also respond, if possible, to questions related to cybersecurity or our products.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>CommunityIQ</b> is a threat monitoring service for Windows and Mac which sends information about a threat detected in your device (samples of suspicious files and detection metadata) to our server, so we can observe how the threat spreads and block it. This is vital for the functioning of our Antivirus and our ability to keep your device secure.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Deepfake Guard</b> works to detect deepfakes and identify scams (e.g., investment scams, crypto scams, giveaway scams) in streaming video.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Email Guard</b> is a cloud-based service which monitors and scans emails from supported providers for potential threats. We create and store non-personal numeric representations of the text to help us detect potential scams and other unwanted messages. Unless you opt out, we store the whole email message (EML file with message metadata) we identified as suspected malicious to further analyze it and include it in our detection models. This helps us keep better detections and improve protection against scams. Our human reviewers may check email messages in case it is needed to investigate the accuracy of our detections (esp. in case of false negatives or false positives). Suspicious messages in the raw form are stored for 30 days and then we remove personal identifiers and keep them in our malware database. To connect to Gmail accounts, we need to ask Google for permission to use its APIs. Google allows companies to use its APIs only if they undertake to limit its use of information accessed through the APIs. As a result, Product’s use and transfer to any other product of information received from these Google APIs will adhere to <a href="https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy#additional_requirements_for_specific_api_scopes" target="_blank">Google API Services User Data Policy</a>, including the Limited Use requirements.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Hack Alerts</b> searches and monitors email addresses associated with your Account for data breaches to alert you when your data has been compromised in a breach and your information is exposed on the dark web. This is done in cooperation with our partner SpyCloud which checks your credentials against its repository of stolen accounts. For further information please refer to its privacy policy <a href="https://spycloud.com/privacy-policy/" target="_blank">here</a>.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Privacy features</b> (Browser Shield, Webcam Shield, Sensitive Data Shield and other similar shields) provide an extra layer of protection for your browser data, passwords, sensitive documents, webcam, microphone or other assets against malware and unauthorized access. Sensitive data shield checks your hard drive and looks for files that contain sensitive data. It helps secure your private data by controlling which applications and users have access to selected files.</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>

<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Antivirus for Mobile (Android) provides people with essential mobile cybersecurity with added privacy features. It helps block malware, check the safety of installed apps, and scan public Wi-Fi networks for possible security weaknesses.</p>

<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>App Insights</strong> provides the user with an evaluation of installed apps based on data collected and permissions asked by the app compared to similar apps. The feature also compares its findings with the app’s privacy policy declarations. </li>

<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Call Guard</strong> helps identify scam, junk, or business calls. Calls can be either labelled or automatically blocked per user preference. The feature is provided in cooperation with Hiya Inc.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Email Guard </strong>is a cloud-based service which monitors and scans emails from supported providers for potential threats. Our human reviewers may check email messages in case it is needed to investigate the accuracy of our detections (esp. in case of false negatives or false positives). To connect to Gmail accounts, we need to ask Google for permission to use its APIs. <div id="text-text-70211baf0b" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>Core Functionality</h4>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Avast Mobile Security for iOS provides protection for your browsing, passwords, photos and Wi-Fi. The product consists of several free and paid features, such as Hack Alerts and VPN, which are described in detail below.</p>

<div id="text-text-3a0ec8432c" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>What are Product’s Features</h4>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Smart Scan</strong> scans your device for malware apps and files and various types of cybersecurity vulnerabilities.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Network inspector and Wi-Fi Speed Check</strong> enables you to scan your network for vulnerabilities, and tests the speed of the network.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Web Guard</strong> helps detect and notify you when accessing a malicious website that could represent a potential online security risk for you.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Hack Alerts</strong> looks for leaked personal information, whether your data has been compromised in a breach and your information is exposed on the dark web. If we identify new breaches we alert you based on the email address you submitted. This is done in cooperation with our partner SpyCloud which checks your credentials against its repository of stolen accounts. For further information please refer to its privacy policy <a href="https://spycloud.com/privacy-policy" target="_blank" rel="nofollow">here</a>.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Photo Vault</strong> locks your photos in an encrypted vault and helps secure them with a PIN, Touch ID, or Face ID so that only you have access to them.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>VPN </strong>feature helps protect your online privacy by encrypting your online communication. It allows you to pick a specific location to be connected from. Our <a href="https://www.avast.com/vpn-policy#pc">VPN Policy</a> (together with any other documents referred to in it) sets out the basis on which any data we collect from you, or that you provide to us, will be processed by us.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>SMS Guard</strong> scans incoming messages for potential scam.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Call Guard</strong> helps identify scam, junk, or business calls. Calls can be either labelled or automatically blocked per user preference. The feature is provided in cooperation with Hiya Inc.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Email Guard</strong> is a cloud-based service which monitors and scans emails from supported providers for potential threats. We create and store non-personal numeric representations of the text to help us detect potential scams and other unwanted messages. Unless you opt out, we store the whole email message (EML file with message metadata) we identified as suspected malicious to further analyze it and include it in our detection models. This helps us keep better detections and improve protection against scams. Our human reviewers may check email messages in case it is needed to investigate the accuracy of our detections (esp. in case of false negatives or false positives). Suspicious messages in the raw form are stored for 30 days and then we remove personal identifiers and keep them in our malware database. To connect to Gmail accounts, we need to ask Google for permission to use its APIs. Google allows companies to use its APIs only if they undertake to limit its use of information accessed through the APIs. As a result,<strong> </strong>Product’s use and transfer to any other product of information received from these Google APIs will adhere to <a href="https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy#additional_requirements_for_specific_api_scopes" target="_blank" style="background-color: rgb(255,255,255);">Google API Services User Data Policy</a>, including the Limited Use requirements.</li>
</ul>

<p class="t-rtf-style--body3"><a href="https://www.avast.com/antitrack#pc">Avast AntiTrack Premium</a>, <a href="https://www.avast.com/antitrack#mac">Avast AntiTrack for Mac</a>, <a href="https://www.avast.com/antitrack#android">Avast AntiTrack for Android</a> (collectively as “AntiTrack”)</p>

<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-722a5a4ffa" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>

<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-4b31c2cca6" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>Core Functionality</h3>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">AntiTrack helps keep your online activities and digital footprint private. Its key features help to obscure your identity from tracking and fingerprinting attempts made by browsers and individual websites.</p>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-dfa943cf29" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>

<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-4ecdfe6edb" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>What are the Product’s Features</h3>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>AntiFingerprinting</strong> helps stop scripts from fingerprinting the user’s device and tracking their browsing behavior across the web.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Fingerprint Randomizer</strong> will automatically change the user’s digital ‘Fingerprint’ in regular intervals, or allow the user to manually change said ‘Fingerprint’.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Browser cleanup</strong> helps the user manage browsing history and cookies by allowing the user to manually clear this information or schedule an automatic deletion at a specific time.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Browser protection</strong> helps users stay protected from online tracking attempts and similar threats through supported browsers. Any time a suspicious script (tracking attempt) encounters the user’s ‘Fingerprint’, the user is notified.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Allowed Websites and whitelisting processes</strong> allows the user to add their favorite websites into the Allowed Websites list so that their stored browser data is not be cleared during the automatic and manual cookie clearing process. Additionally, no anti-tracking measures will be active on these websites once they are added to the Allowed Websites list.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>System Privacy</strong> helps stop third parties from seeing, tracking, and collecting customer information from the supported operating system. Specifically, this is related to the customer’s computer login security, protecting files and data on that machine, and keeping the customer’s computer activities private. </li>
</ul>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>

<div id="text-text-bad93131a0" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>Core Functionality</h3>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Our goal is to enable people to take back their privacy online. Help remediate past breaches and minimise the risk of abuse of their data in the future. <br />
 </p>
<ol>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3">Helping users to discover and fix online privacy threats.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3">Help prevent data collection by advertising companies and data brokers, depending on region.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3">Educating users about privacy and security online.</li>
</ol>
 
</div>

<div id="text-text-1e43a39fde" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>What are Product’s Features</h3>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Risk Monitor</strong> provides dark web monitoring for leaked personal information. BreachGuard leverages a comprehensive database of the dark web – it works to detect whether users have been compromised in a breach and their information is exposed on the dark web. If we identify new breaches we alert you based on the email address you submitted. This is done in cooperation with our partner SpyCloud which checks your credentials against its repository of stolen accounts. For further information please refer to its privacy policy <a href="https://spycloud.com/privacy-policy/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow">here</a>. The feature also has the capability, if you consent, to scan your browser for weak, reused or breached passwords and provides instructions to fix these passwords.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Personal info remover</strong> submits opt-out requests on your behalf to available data brokers in North America. </li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Privacy Advisor</strong> provides updates and guidance related to online privacy, including but not limited to: recent data breaches and guides to optimize your privacy for social media sites and other common services. If you opt-in, this functionality will process your bookmarks and browsing history to improve the quality of content so we can distinguish guides which are relevant to you (we are not processing full urls but we need only the domain name).</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Identity Assist</strong> We have partnered with a third party, Generali Global Assistance, to provide Identity Assist in BreachGuard. The service consists of two sub-features, ScamAssist and Identity Resolution. ScamAssist specialists act as trusted advisors to customers by helping them identify which of the solicitations they have received are potentially fraudulent. Resolution Specialists are available 24/7 to educate customers about how identity theft and cyberthreats occur, as well as provide tips and tools to help keep their online identity and digital privacy secure. Note we do not process any personal data from your interaction with Generali, Generali does, see its privacy policy <a href="https://www.generali.com/info/privacy/privacy-information" target="_blank" rel="nofollow">here</a>.</li>
</ul>

  <h4>What are Product’s Features</h4>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Avast Cleanup Premium for Windows:<br />
 </p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Maintenance</b> scans and deletes registry items, shortcuts, system and programs temp or unnecessary files, browser caches, history and cookies.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Program Deactivators</b> scans and disables installed third-party programs which have background, startup or scheduled tasks.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Software, Disk </b>or<b> Browser Cleaner</b> scan and temporarily hide or uninstall third-party programs, deletes unnecessary files from disk or browser history.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Fix Problems</b> scans and help fix common Windows problems which might put PC at risk (e.g. missing Windows updates, administrative shares on public folders).</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Disk Doctor</b> or <b>Defrag</b> scans for potential errors and works to fix system drive or defrag your system drive.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Software Updater</b> scans and provides updates to third-party programs and their versions installed on PC.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Cloud Cleaner</b> feature helps users manage their cloud storage (optimize, remove duplicates) and Google Mail (clean old or large marketing emails) by checking metadata associated with stored files, pictures and emails. Files, pictures and emails are not downloaded or stored by us. To connect to Google Drive and Google Mail, we need to ask Google for permission to use its APIs. Google allows companies to use its APIs only if they undertake to limit its use of information accessed through the APIs. As a result, Product’s use and transfer to any other product of information received from these Google APIs will adhere to <a href="https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy#additional_requirements_for_specific_api_scopes" target="_blank">Google API Services User Data Policy</a>, including the Limited Use requirements.</li>

<p class="t-rtf-style--body3"><a href="https://www.avast.com/cleanup-android">Avast Cleanup</a>, <a href="https://www.avast.com/cleanup-android">Avast Cleanup Premium</a> (collectively as “Cleanup for Mobile (Android)”)</p>

<div id="text-text-6b97d8f82b" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>Core Functionality</h4>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Cleanup for Mobile (Android) helps detect and remove unnecessary files to free up storage space. Equally, it can help stop running processes to optimize device performance.</p>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-325ef962b1" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>

<div id="text-text-185d61068a" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>What are Product’s Features</h4>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>App Overview</strong> allows to browse installed and pre-installed applications, provides functionality to uninstall or stop. In particular, this feature relies on processing device provided stats about other apps. These stats are processed locally (on device) in order to provide the service.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Media Overview</strong> provides an overview of files broken down by type (e.g. images, audio files, video). This feature does not need any specific data processing outside of operations made locally (on device).</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Battery Saver</strong> allows you to select conditions where desired actions (system settings changes) should be applied by this product. For example one can automatically decrease screen brightness when at home. Location based condition require permission to get location data, however these data are never transmitted from the device and all are processed locally.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Cloud Transfers</strong> allows you to backup files to an external cloud storage. We are using Google Drive and Dropbox APIs to do so, e.g. you can login using their Google or Dropbox credentials to establish such connections. Note credentials are not visible to us.</li>
</ul>
 
</div>

<div id="text-text-283041aec9" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h2><a id="familyspace"></a>Family Space</h2>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-d121738c06" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__20px c-spacer__desktop__32px      "></div>
</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-3934f9a829" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>Official Product Name</h3>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Avast Family Space</p>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-9356635a13" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>
</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-d30adbdaba" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>Core Functionality</h3>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Avast Family Space is a free mobile application for Android and iOS which helps keep your kids safe both online and off with its advanced parental controls and location features.</p>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-fe907e06b0" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>
</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-e2455a9211" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>Personal Data We Process and Features</h3>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">While using Family Space, we process the following Service and Device Data (in addition to Billing Data and Account Data):</p>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>1. Location feature</strong></p>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Parents are able to install the parent’s app on their own device and kids app on children’s devices. After activation, parents are able to locate their children on demand or set up automatic location alerts based on time or geofencing. Parents have the option to share their own location as well.</p>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-cd20ef6f05" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>
</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-3610842ba4" class="cmp-text  cmp-text--is-legal    is-rtf">
  <table cellpadding="16" cellspacing="0" border="1" width="100%" height="0">
<tbody><tr><th scope="col" valign="top">Location Data Feature</th>
<th scope="col" valign="top">What we use it for and for how long</th>
</tr><tr><td valign="top"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">Child location</span></td>
<td><p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"><strong>Service Provision</strong> (12 months)</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">We collect the child’s geolocation GPS coordinates while the app is running in the foreground and background in order to show parents the child’s current location, last-known location, and location history</span></li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">Children can also send their location from within the app. For example, Check-In and Pick Me Up are features that send the current location</span></li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">If the child has more than one device paired, location data is only collected from the most recently-used device</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"> </span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"><strong>Product and Business Improvement</strong> (12 months)<br />
</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">We use this data to train machine learning algorithms to notify parents when a child is in an unexpected place at a given time</span></li>
</ul>
</td>
</tr><tr><td valign="top"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">Parent location</span></td>
<td><p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"><strong>Service Provision</strong> (12 months)<br />
</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">Parents can find a setting to share their location with all family members, other parents or off. The setting is off by default</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"> </span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"><strong>Product and Business Improvement</strong> (up to 24 months)<br />
</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">We track behavior such as turning this setting on or off, but we don’t send location coordinates to third party analytics services</span></li>
</ul>
</td>
</tr><tr><td valign="top"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">Saved locations</span></td>
<td><p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"><strong>Service Provision</strong> (12 months)<br />
</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">Parents can enter a saved location for use in geofencing alerts. They can be alerted when a child enters or exits that saved location, such as home or school</span></li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">Time spent at unsaved locations may be used to recommend a new saved location to parents</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"> </span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"><strong>New Product Development</strong> (12 months)</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">Saved Locations may be used in machine learning location anomaly detection. For example, when a child is at a saved location, it may not warrant an alert about unexpected behavior</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"> </span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"><strong>Product and Business Improvement</strong> (up to 24 months)</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">We track feature usage data to third parties for analytics, but not names or locations of saved places</span></li>
</ul>
</td>
</tr></tbody></table>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-ee81cf4e43" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>
</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-39538a3ff2" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <p class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>2. Activity feature</strong></p>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Parents are able to view web and app activity from their children’s devices. The summary view categorizes connections made by category and the list view shows specific usage information.</p>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-d9c812c463" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>
</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-7c4323d764" class="cmp-text  cmp-text--is-legal    is-rtf">
  <table cellpadding="16" cellspacing="0" border="1" width="100%" height="0">
<tbody><tr><th scope="col" valign="top">Activity Data Feature</th>
<th scope="col" valign="top">What we use it for and for how long</th>
</tr><tr><td valign="top"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">DNS connections, device and app usage</span></td>
<td valign="top"><p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"><strong>Service Provision</strong> (12 months)<br />
</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">When the child device is connected to our VPN, the device’s IP address and DNS connection information are stored by our partner for 24 hours and then by us for 12 months. We also collect information about whether the device is locked, and whether the screen is on. On Android we also collect device and app usage information from the system. Together these records are used to present a summary and list view of your child’s device, web, and app usage</span></li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">We collect the list of installed apps from the child’s device to display to parents. We may notify the parent when a new app is installed. We do not share the complete app list with any third parties.</span></li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">We may alert parents to activity that might warrant attention, such as activity during late night hours, accessing objectionable content, or spending a lot of time on a new activity</span></li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">We may also display the same information to child app users for greater transparency</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"> </span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"><strong>Product and Business Improvement</strong> (12 months)<br />
</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">We use DNS usage history to develop machine learning models which will be used to notify the parent in case of usage anomalies that might warrant attention</span></li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">We use this data to develop machine learning models to predict how much time the child spends in each app, and on each device</span></li>
</ul>
</td>
</tr></tbody></table>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-d17ca2ba38" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>
</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-b3570c894d" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <p class="t-rtf-style--body3"><span style="">The third-party tool which we use for DNS lookup and content blocking is Akamai. For further information regarding this partner, please refer to their </span><a href="https://www.akamai.com/us/en/about/compliance/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow">Privacy Policy</a><span style="">.</span><br />
</p>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>3. Controls feature</strong></p>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Parents are able to block access to unwanted apps and websites individually or by category. Parents can pause and restore Internet access on demand.</p>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-e93fd3aac4" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>
</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-119c721fe7" class="cmp-text  cmp-text--is-legal    is-rtf">
  <table cellpadding="16" cellspacing="0" border="1" width="100%" height="0">
<tbody><tr><th scope="col" valign="top">Controls Data Feature</th>
<th scope="col" valign="top">What we use it for and for how long</th>
</tr><tr><td valign="top"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">Settings</span></td>
<td valign="top"><p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"><strong>Service Provision</strong> (the lifetime of account)<br />
</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">To store parents’ settings of blocked apps and websites in order to synchronize them across devices and apply the rules to children’s devices</span></li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">We may provide the option to limit the time spent in each app, content category or device</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"> </span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"><strong>Product and Business Improvement<br />
</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">We track feature usage data to third parties for analytics (up to 24 months)</span></li>
</ul>
</td>
</tr><tr><td valign="top"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">Pause internet logs</span></td>
<td valign="top"><p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"><strong>Service Provision</strong> (the lifetime of account)<br />
</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">To store logs of when parents paused and resumed child access to the internet in order to provide customer support and understand usage behavior</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"> </span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"><strong>Product and Business Improvement<br />
</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">We track feature usage data to third parties for analytics (up to 24 months)</span></li>
</ul>
</td>
</tr></tbody></table>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-8eb454a6e1" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>
</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-4b7d9c3c10" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <p class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>4. Family setup</strong></p>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">As a family app running on multiple devices, configuring your family profile is a required step.</p>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-73e46055fe" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>
</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-ff2db07bdb" class="cmp-text  cmp-text--is-legal    is-rtf">
  <table cellpadding="16" cellspacing="0" border="1" width="100%" height="0">

<td valign="top"><p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"><strong>Service Provision</strong> (the lifetime of account or profile)<br />
</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">Parents can enter any name and photo they wish for each family member. This information is then displayed on the devices of other family members as well</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"> </span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);"><strong>Product and Business Improvement</strong> (up to 24 months)<br />
</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body4"><span style="color: rgb(52,89,112);">We track usage information to third parties for analytics, but we don’t send names or photos</span></li>
</ul>
</td>

<div id="text-text-b70291930e" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h2><a id="HackCheck"></a>HackCheck</h2>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-55428c3427" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__20px c-spacer__desktop__32px      "></div>
</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-4739ea96f9" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>Core Functionality</h3>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">HackCheck is a website that allows users to input their email address into a form and check to see if their passwords have been stolen and published on the dark web. The email address is also registered for monitoring and alerting which will send the user an email as soon as a password leak has been detected. Users can unsubscribe from this monitoring anytime.</p>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Lastly, HackCheck offers some cybersecurity tips and directions when or if your passwords have been compromised.</p>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-d1129fbe7d" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>
</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-23f05843a2" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>What are Product’s Features</h3>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Has my password been stolen?</strong> which checks the database operated by our partner SpyCloud against the email address the user provided to see if the user’s passwords have been leaked and sends an email to the user if the passwords leaked.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Automatic Email Alerts</strong> which monitors the SpyCloud database and will send the user an email if their passwords show up in the SpyCloud database.</li>
</ul>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-0574ae26c6" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>
</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-ff98376a7d" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>Personal Data We Process</h3>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">If you wish to use the HackCheck, you submit your email address so we can send you alerts about the passwords that have leaked based on results from SpyCloud Database. This email address is used by us for the purposes of service provision, cross-promotion of our other products and optimization of the service to help us understand how you use our product (e.g. number of detections per email).</p>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Your email address is stored for as long as you use our service, as it is necessary for us to provide it. Should you choose to unsubscribe from our email list your email will be deleted and you will not receive any further emails from us.</p>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">The database of leaked passwords is operated by our partner SpyCloud. For further information please refer to its privacy policy <a href="https://spycloud.com/privacy-policy/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow">here</a>.</p>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">

<div id="text-text-9b8531a89b" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>Official Product Name</h3>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3"><a href="https://www.avast.com/business/business-hub">Avast Business Hub</a></p>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">

</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-509cd93703" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>Core Functionality</h3>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">The Business Hub enables you to deploy various protection services to multiple devices, manage all devices from one place, mix and match device types, schedule regular scans, and quickly add more devices.</p>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Please note that through the Business Hub certain settings related to privacy are managed by and information from managed devices is accessible to the administrator of the console or the Managed Service Provider you chose. Businesses are responsible for informing you about this fact and instructing administrators about best practices to ensure users’ privacy.</p>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-054f3e2ba2" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>
</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-dca4ce6547" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>What are Product’s Features</h3>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Monitor Device Security</strong> uses the console to monitor the health of all managed devices from one place, reviews the number of blocked threats, schedules regular scans, and more.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Management Dashboard</strong> activates devices, adds devices to groups, configures antivirus settings, and views blocked threats from an easy-to-read dashboard.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Master Agent</strong> selects a device as the Local Update Server where all updates can be downloaded and saves bandwidth by scheduling and distributing updates to all endpoints in your network when it’s convenient.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Tasks</strong> sets up cybersecurity tasks for all managed endpoints, such as scans, messages, updates, and shutdowns to ensure optimal security for the entire network.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Updates</strong> remotely downloads and distributes virus and program updates to all devices from one console to save time and bandwidth.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Notifications</strong> include instant email notifications on any cybersecurity threats or network issues that need your attention, including outdated antivirus applications, extended device inactivity, and additional device update.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Reporting</strong> shows detailed reports that include blocked threats, task lists, and protected devices, making it simple to improve cybersecurity and customize protection.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Subscriptions</strong> <strong>Overview</strong> lists all valid subscriptions and licenses.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Network Discovery</strong> scans your network for connected devices to bring visibility over what devices should be taken care of.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Cloud Backup</strong> stores selected data in the cloud as backup in case of data loss or disaster resulting in data loss/damage.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Remote Control</strong> enables IT admins to connect to a user’s device, access files and applications, and help troubleshoot issues in real time.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Patch Management</strong> - scans for missing operating system updates and third-party application patches and enables remote installation of those patches to resolve application vulnerabilities of endpoints.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Content Filtering</strong> boosts productivity and cybersecurity by controlling your employees’ internet usage and allowing to restrict their access to specific websites or website categories.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>USB Protection</strong> is a service allowing you to control access to USB flash drives, external HDDs, optical discs, memory cards, digital cameras, smartphones (Windows only), tablets (Windows only), and other devices that have storage capabilities. With this service, removable devices won’t be able to access your end users’ data without permission.</li>
</ul>
 
</div>

<div id="text-text-da58d7d052" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">

<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Avast Business CloudCare</p>

<div id="spacer-65b8a74d56" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>

<div id="text-text-8f1c740ff4" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>Core Functionality</h3>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">CloudCare enables you to deploy various protection services to multiple devices, manage all devices from one place, mix and match device types, schedule regular scans, and quickly add more devices It also allows you to purchase subscriptions and manage them conveniently from a single platform.</p>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Please note that, through CloudCare, certain settings related to privacy are managed by and information from managed devices is accessible to the administrator of the console or the Managed Service Provider you chose. Businesses are responsible for informing you about this fact and instructing administrators about best practices to ensure users’ privacy.</p>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-9b28a99b2f" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>

<div id="text-text-8732b08c66" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>What are Product’s Features</h3>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Dashboard</strong> allows you to monitor the status of the managed devices, including their cybersecurity, allocation of subscriptions and service usage.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Alerts</strong> allow you to configure and customize alerts which, if triggered by certain events, will be sent to selected users by email and/or texted to mobile numbers (available for selected wireless service providers).</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Devices</strong> provide detailed information on the status and active services for each enrolled device. It gives you the tools to deploy CloudCare services to more devices.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Policies</strong> give you the ability to define sets of rules and settings for each service that will be enforced on the endpoint devices.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Account</strong> and services allow you to view and manage the information we store about your company, users and companies that you added to the platform. It also allows you to buy and manage subscriptions that entitle you to use particular service on a particular set of devices.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Community forum</strong> allows CloudCare partners to discuss their issues, needs, and provide feedback on CloudCare. This forum is also attended by our customer care staff.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Master Agent</strong> selects a device as the Local Update Server where all updates can be downloaded and saves bandwidth by scheduling and distributing updates to all endpoints in your network when it’s convenient.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Updates</strong> remotely downloads and distributes virus and program updates to all devices from one console to save time and bandwidth.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Reports</strong> provide on-demand summary of blocked threats, task lists, and protected devices, making it simple to improve cybersecurity and customize the protection.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Online Backup</strong> stores selected data in the cloud as backup in case of data loss or disaster resulting in data loss/damage.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Remote Control</strong> enables IT admins to connect to a user’s device, access files and applications, and help troubleshoot issues in real time.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Patch Management</strong> scans for missing operating system updates and third-party application patches and enables remote installation of those patches to resolve application vulnerabilities of endpoints.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Secure Web Gateway</strong> inspects all web connections using DNS-layer protection and full web proxy. It also inspects full SSL and non-SSL paths for risky and new sites.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Content Filtering</strong> boosts productivity and cybersecurity by controlling your employees’ internet usage, helps prevent devices from accessing malicious content, and allows the admin to restrict access to specific sites or content categories.</li>
</ul>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>

<div id="text-text-493a52370a" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>What are Product’s Features</h4>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Device Scan</b> scans your device or a specific file for malware apps and files and various types of cybersecurity vulnerabilities. </li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Malware Shields</b> scans new apps and files being downloaded to the device for malware. </li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>VPN</b> feature helps protect your online privacy by encrypting your online communication. It allows you to pick a specific location to be connected from.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Wi-Fi Scan</b> enables you to scan your network for vulnerabilities and encourages you to connect to VPN if any issues are detected.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Web Shield</b> helps detect and notify you when accessing a malicious website that could represent a potential online security risk for you.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Data Breach Scan and Monitoring</b> looks for leaked personal information, whether your data has been compromised in a breach and your information is exposed on the dark web. If we identify new breaches we alert you based on the email address you submitted. This is done in cooperation with our partner SpyCloud which checks your credentials against its repository of stolen accounts. For further information please refer to its privacy policy <a href="https://spycloud.com/privacy-policy/" target="_blank">here</a>.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Performance Scan</b> analyzes the space on your device and displays the amount of storage space that is being used by junk files. Also, it detects apps running in the background of your device that can be stopped in order to free up the device's memory and speed it up.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Online Safety</b> <b>Score</b> analyzes data collected by Avast One such as files scanned for malware and websites scanned for dangerous links and provides you with an insight into your behavior.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Email Guard</b> is a cloud-based service which monitors and scans emails from supported providers for potential threats. We create and store non-personal numeric representations of the text to help us detect potential scams and other unwanted messages. Unless you opt out, we store the whole email message (EML file with message metadata) we identified as suspected malicious to further analyze it and include it in our detection models. This helps us keep better detections and improve protection against scams. Our human reviewers may check email messages in case it is needed to investigate the accuracy of our detections (esp. in case of false negatives or false positives). Suspicious messages in the raw form are stored for 30 days and then we remove personal identifiers and keep them in our malware database. To connect to Gmail accounts, we need to ask Google for permission to use its APIs. Google allows companies to use its APIs only if they undertake to limit its use of information accessed through the APIs. As a result,<b> </b>Product’s use and transfer to any other product of information received from these Google APIs will adhere to <a href="https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy#additional_requirements_for_specific_api_scopes" target="_blank" rel="nofollow">Google API Services User Data Policy</a>, including the Limited Use requirements.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>SMS Guard</b> scans incoming messages for potential scam.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Scam Protection </b>works to warn you if you tap a dangerous link from any email, SMS, or messaging app by checking the URLs you visit.</li>
</ul>

<div id="text-text-47db30565d" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>Core Functionality</h4>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Avast One (iOS) includes a comprehensive set of features that provide protection against potential online security and privacy threats, and features for optimizing device’s performance. </p>
 
</div>

<div id="text-text-ce10b807db" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>What are Product’s Features</h4>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>VPN </b>feature helps protect your online privacy by encrypting your online communication. The paid version of Avast One Premium allows you to pick a specific location to be connected from.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Web Shield</b> helps detect and notify you when accessing a malicious website that could represent a potential online security risk for you.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Photo Vault</b> locks your photos in an encrypted vault and helps secure them with a PIN, Touch ID, or Face ID so that only you have access to them.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Data Breach</b> <b>Monitoring</b> looks for leaked personal information, whether your data has been compromised in a breach and your information is exposed on the dark web. If we identify new breaches we alert you based on the email address you submitted. This is done in cooperation with our partner SpyCloud which checks your credentials against its repository of stolen accounts. For further information please refer to its privacy policy <a href="https://spycloud.com/privacy-policy/" target="_blank">here</a>.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Online Safety</b> <b>Score</b> analyzes data collected by Avast One such as files scanned for malware and websites scanned for dangerous links and provides you with an insight into your behavior.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>Email Guard</b> is a cloud-based service which monitors and scans emails from supported providers for potential threats. We create and store non-personal numeric representations of the text to help us detect potential scams and other unwanted messages. Unless you opt out, we store the whole email message (EML file with message metadata) we identified as suspected malicious to further analyze it and include it in our detection models. This helps us keep better detections and improve protection against scams. Our human reviewers may check email messages in case it is needed to investigate the accuracy of our detections (esp. in case of false negatives or false positives). Suspicious messages in the raw form are stored for 30 days and then we remove personal identifiers and keep them in our malware database. To connect to Gmail accounts, we need to ask Google for permission to use its APIs. Google allows companies to use its APIs only if they undertake to limit its use of information accessed through the APIs. As a result,<b> </b>Product’s use and transfer to any other product of information received from these Google APIs will adhere to <a href="https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy#additional_requirements_for_specific_api_scopes" target="_blank">Google API Services User Data Policy</a>, including the Limited Use requirements.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><b>SMS Guard</b> scans incoming messages for potential scam.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3">Scam protection works to warn you if you tap a dangerous link from any email, SMS, or messaging app by checking the URLs you visit.</li>
</ul>

<div id="text-text-03b9c3efa6" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>Core Functionality</h4>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Avast One offers a comprehensive set of features that provide protection against potential online security and privacy threats, and features for optimizing device’s performance. Concrete set of features available to you may differ based on the version of the product.</p>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>
<div class="spacer">





    











<div id="spacer-a9f3d77a9f" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>
</div>
<div class="text">









<div id="text-text-55341e8830" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>What are Product’s Features</h4>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Cybersecurity</strong><ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Smart Scan</strong> is a comprehensive scan that helps detect browser threats, outdated applications, hidden viruses, system issues, online privacy threats and other issues depending on the provided features.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Protection features</strong> provide core defenses for blocking malware and other threats including protection against malicious or suspicious files, QR codes, programs, applications, commands, scripts and code, instructions, skill packages, web attacks and unsafe downloads, unauthorized remote access attempts, AI agent actions, or dangerous email attachments. Based on the features available, we help protect your device, files, browser data, passwords, sensitive documents, webcam, microphone or other assets against malware, unauthorized access, or other unwanted events. To do this, we scan and analyze files, programs, applications, attachments, URLs, code or other sources for potential threats. Sometimes, we may directly analyze and maintain these artifacts in our safe environment to make sure our users are protected.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Network inspector</strong> scans for vulnerabilities and potential security issues in your network (including for example router and connected devices).</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Firewall </strong>helps control what data goes in and out of your computer to block traffic from malicious sources and prevent unauthorized access to your device.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Sensitive data shield</strong> checks your hard drive and looks for files that contain sensitive data. It helps secure your private data by controlling which applications and users have access to selected files.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>CommunityIQ</strong> is a threat monitoring service for Windows and Mac which sends information about a threat detected in your device (samples of suspicious files and detection metadata) to our server, so we can observe how the threat spreads and block it. This is vital for the functioning of our Antivirus and our ability to keep your device secure.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Scam Guardian and Assistant</strong> features help block potentially dangerous websites and analyze texts, emails, messages or other media to avoid scams. It can also respond, if possible, to questions related to cybersecurity or our products.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Email Guard</strong> (on the web) is a cloud-based service which monitors emails from supported providers for potential threats. By default, we don’t store the emails, but we create and store non-personal numeric representations of the text to detect potential scam and other unwanted messages. You can allow us to store the whole email message (EML file with message metadata) we identified as suspected malicious by consenting to it in the product. This helps us keep better detections and improve the protection against scams. Our human reviewers may check the email message in case it is needed to investigate the accuracy of our detections (esp. in case of false negatives or false positives). Suspicious messages in the raw form are stored for 30 days and then we remove personal identifiers and keep them in our malware database. To connect to Gmail accounts, we need to ask Google for permission to use its APIs. Google allows companies to use its APIs only if they undertake to limit its use of information accessed through the APIs. As a result, Product’s use and transfer to any other product of information received from these Google APIs will adhere to <a href="https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy#additional_requirements_for_specific_api_scopes" target="_blank">Google API Services User Data Policy</a>, including the Limited Use requirements.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Deepfake Guard</strong> works to detect deepfakes and identify scams (e.g., investment scams, crypto scams, giveaway scams) in streaming video.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>AI Agent Protection</strong> is a security layer that sits between the supported AI agents and your system. Before a supported agent action is executed (e.g. running a command, downloading a file, writing to disk), AI Agent Protection checks it first and either allows it, blocks it, or asks you for input. AI Agent Protection runs its core detection engine locally on your computer. Your commands, source code, file content, and file paths are all analyzed on-device. To provide effective protection, AI Agent Protection also makes a few cloud-based checks to strengthen our protection including URL, skill package and tool reputation checks.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Email Guard</strong> (on your device) scans for threats in your incoming and outgoing email messages and attachments. Scanning applies only to messages sent or received using mail management software, such as Microsoft Outlook, Apple Mail or Mozilla Thunderbird.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Privacy features</strong> provide an extra layer of protection for your online privacy. Based on the features available, it can include services such as VPN, dark web leak monitoring and tracking prevention. Dark web monitoring looks for leaked personal information, whether your data has been compromised in a breach and your information is exposed on the dark web. If we identify new breaches we alert you based on the email address you submitted. This is done in cooperation with our partner SpyCloud which checks your credentials against its repository of stolen accounts. For further information please refer to its privacy policy <a href="https://spycloud.com/legal/privacy-policy/" target="_blank">here</a>. The feature also has the capability, if you consent, to scan your browser for weak, reused or breached passwords and provides instructions to fix these passwords. </li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Performance features</strong> help optimize your PC by removing duplicate or junk files, optimizing apps, or updating drivers and software.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Selected versions</strong> of the product include Secure Identity features such as credit monitoring, transaction monitoring, social media monitoring, alerts to help you determine if your identity has been compromised and specialist support. These features are provided in cooperation with Sontiq, Inc. We share your name, surname, license ID and email with Sontiq so that they can prepare the service for you. The data processing within the product is governed by this <a href="https://www.sontiq.com/privacy-policy" target="_blank">Privacy Notice</a>.</li>
</ul>

<div id="text-text-f74a55704e" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>Core Functionality</h3>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Online Security & Privacy is a browser extension (or plug-in). that helps check if the site isn’t malicious or phishing.</p>

<div id="text-text-927ee24b6d" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>What are Product’s Features</h3>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Antivirus</strong> checks the links in search results for potentially malicious webpages.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Anti-phishing</strong> helps identify and block phishing sites trying to steal your data.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Anti-tracking</strong> helps block tracking cookies that collect data on your browsing activities.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Marking Search Results</strong> works to determine if the site is safe or not even before the user visits it.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Advertising Data Collection</strong> helps opt out from ads based on user personal interests.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Privacy Advisor</strong> allows optimizing privacy settings on the most popular online platforms via step-by-step guidance.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Global Privacy Control</strong> is a <a href="https://globalprivacycontrol.org/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow">third-party solution</a> we have implemented in the settings that is designed to send websites a “GPC” signal requesting to opt out of selling or sharing personal information on that website. See the specifics <a href="https://globalprivacycontrol.org/#gpc-spec" target="_blank" rel="nofollow">here</a>.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Cookie Manager</strong> works to automatically accept or decline cookie consent preference banners while users browse the web.</li>
</ul>
 
</div>

<div id="text-text-2fe846c75b" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>Core Functionality</h3>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">SafePrice is a browser extension available for Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Safari. Whenever you visit an online shop or product site, SafePrice will show relevant price comparison and discount coupons.</p>
 
</div>

<div id="text-text-11644eb887" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h3>What are Product’s Features</h3>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Discount coupons</strong> and other promotional offers are typically provided by store owners to incentivize purchases. This means that these coupons are relevant to specific domains, and sometimes specific pages only. In order to be able to offer relevant coupons, we need to check the current page URL against a list of available offers.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Price Comparison</strong> looks for specific portions of the HTML code which allows it to identify basic information about the product you are shopping for – product name, SKU and current price. We then compare this information with a database of prices provided by our partners, and offer cheaper prices for the same product where available.<br />
 </li>
</ul>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3"><span>Information about available offers, coupons or cheaper prices is obtained from CouponFollow or Ciuvo. We request this content based on the information obtained from the page, your language settings, country level location and search query within SafePrice. Once you click on the offer, your request will be processed by CouponFollow/NextGen Shopping (in accordance with their <a href="https://couponfollow.com/partners/privacy-policy" target="_blank">privacy policy</a>) or Ciuvo according to its <a href="https://www.ciuvo.com/en/privacy" target="_blank">privacy policy</a>.</span></p>

<div id="text-text-0e77cda1ad" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>Official Product Name</h4>

<div id="text-text-467f45571f" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>Core Functionality</h4>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Secure Browser for Desktop is a product currently offered for PC Windows and for macOS users.</p>
 
</div>

<div id="spacer-27a53b1f5d" class="c-spacer  c-spacer__mobile__32px c-spacer__desktop__48px      "></div>

<div id="text-text-25d8aaff61" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>What are Product’s Features</h4>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Browser Security & Privacy Center</strong> is built in Security & Privacy Center which is a curated collection of some key cybersecurity and privacy features, tools and settings, organized into one management console making it easier for you to control and manage your online privacy and security.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>WebShield</strong> helps protect you from accessing dangerous websites, such as fake sites, phishing sites, sites that have harmful programs such as adware, spyware, ransomware, viruses, or other malware or scam content that aim at stealing or misusing your information. It includes https scanning that decrypts and scans encrypted traffic of selected websites to help detect potential malware contained on sites using https connections. All scanning occurs locally on your PC during the HTTPS connection, and no one outside of your device can read or decipher the connection.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Scam protection</strong> helps detect potential scam attempts by analyzing URLs, content such as adverts on social media sites and features related to website’s visual appearance for suspicious indications (brand impersonation prediction and other phishing threats).</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Privacy Cleaner</strong> works to clean your browser history, cookies including 3rd party, cached images, and other tracking scripts to help ensure that your online activity is private as well as free up space on your device.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Privacy Guard</strong> is a built-in extension that helps make your online experience cleaner, faster, safer, and more private. It comprises Adblocker (helps stop ads from loading), Anti-tracker (helps block tracking scripts and cookies), and Anti-Fingerprint (helps disguise your browser fingerprint to prevent websites from tracking you) features all in one. Privacy Guard collects and displays the number of blocked 3rd party calls from external sources.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Sync</strong> means you can sign into the browser using your Avast ID or Google account. Your browsing data (including bookmarks, history, settings, open tabs, passwords, address, phone numbers, and payment information) will be then backed up and available across all your devices. If you sign into the browser using your Avast ID, we receive information that you sync across devices in encrypted form, and we are not able to access it or read it.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Built-in VPN</strong> (virtual private network) creates an encrypted connection between your device and the internet, helping secure your browsing data. This VPN feature does not track or store connection timestamps, session information, bandwidth usage, traffic data, IP addresses, or other similar data.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Avast Addons Store</strong> is an online store that allows you to view and install a wide range of extensions.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Extension Guard</strong> is a built-in extension that helps protect against spammy, fake, or malware browser extensions.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Webcam Guard</strong> helps protect against unauthorized access to your device camera. </li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Video Downloader</strong> is an extension that allows you to convert and download videos from YouTube and other social media platforms.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>HackCheck</strong> – see the HackCheck <a href="#HackCheck">section</a>.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Accuweather widget</strong> – used to display weather information on the new tab page based on the approximate location (derived from the IP address) and device model/OS.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Coupons</strong> – used to track and offer coupon codes and deals from online merchants to help you save money. The service is powered by our partner NextGen Shopping, LLC.<br />
</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Vio/FindHotel</strong> (Hermes SDK) helps users compare hotel prices while browsing supported travel websites. The extension identifies eligible travel pages, extracts the information required to perform a price comparison, retrieves hotel offers from the Vio Partners API, and displays those offers directly within the browsing experience through buttons, banners, and pop-up elements. Telemetry (events such as pop-up/button displayed, page type category) is page-view based and not tied to a user or device. No persistent user identifiers, full URLs, search terms, paths, or query strings, device fingerprints, IP addresses are collected by the SDK in telemetry payloads. Telemetry is limited to essential signals needed for core functionality, quality assurance, and debugging. FindHotel privacy policy is available on www.vio.com.</li>
</ul>
 
</div>

    


    

</div>

<div id="text-text-213a7984e0" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>Personal Data We Process</h4>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">By default, Secure Browser for Desktop processes locally on your system the following data:</p>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3">Browsing history information; for example Secure Browser for Desktop may store the URLs of pages that you visit, a cache of text, images and other resources from those pages. If the pre-rendering feature is turned on, a list of IP addresses linked to those pages may also be stored for some period of time;</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3">Name, surname, email or passwords to help you fill out forms or signs in to sites you visit;</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3">Permission that you have granted to websites;</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3">Cookies or data from websites that you visit;</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3">Data saved by add-ons;</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3">Record of what you downloaded from websites;</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3">IP addresses are not stored, only used for product localization and analytics purposes based on approximate location (city/country level);</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3">Passwords and associated information within the Password Manager feature.<br />
 </li>
</ul>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3"><span>This data is not sent to our environment. You can manage this data within Secure Browser for Desktop in the Settings page.</span><br />
</p>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">However, if you enable the Sync feature, we will process relevant browsing data in our environment to ensure the sync across your devices.</p>

<div id="text-text-b4723fdaff" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>Core Functionality</h4>
<p class="t-rtf-style--body3">Secure Browser for Mobile is a mobile browser offered for Android and iOS users. </p>

<div id="text-text-6a3ee495ea" class="cmp-text      is-rtf">
  <h4>What are Product’s Features</h4>
<ul>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Browser Security & Privacy Center</strong> is built in Security & Privacy Center which is a curated collection of some key cybersecurity and privacy features, tools and settings, organized into one management console making it easier for you to control and manage your online privacy and cybersecurity.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Adblock</strong> helps stop ads being shown in your browser using publicly available blocking lists.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Anti-Tracking</strong> helps prevent the user from being tracked across websites by avoiding tracking cookies to be created. This is done using publicly available blocking lists.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Anti-Fingerprinting</strong> helps prevent the user from being tracked across websites using browser fingerprinting techniques. As fingerprinting itself cannot be prevented or avoided, this feature alters the digital fingerprint of the user's browser in a way that third-party sites should not be able to re-identify it.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Web Shield</strong> helps protect you from accessing dangerous websites, such as fake sites, phishing sites, sites that have harmful content such as adware, spyware, ransomware, viruses, all types of other malware that aim at stealing your information.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Phishing protection</strong> helps detect potential new scam attempts by analyzing URLs and features related to website’s visual appearance for suspicious indications (brand impersonation prediction and other phishing threats). The information is only collected for URLs/webpages that exhibit characteristics suggestive of potential phishing threats.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Built-in VPN</strong> (virtual private network) creates an encrypted tunnel between your device and the internet, making your browsing data safer.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Security Scanner</strong> feature will scan the device, its internet connection and browser configuration for threats and vulnerabilities, process the findings, and display a result screen with potential improvements.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Nuke</strong> works to clean your browser history, cached images, cookies including both first-party and third-party cookies, and other junk.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Remove Site Data</strong> helps clean your browser history, site cookies, and offline data with the current site.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Video Downloader</strong> enables you to download videos from supported websites to your device.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Media Vault</strong> allocates your files, including those you download during your browsing sessions, to the browser application’s encrypted file system. These files are stored on your device and are accessible through the browser application.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Secure Mode</strong> encrypts your DNS queries, helps stop ads being shown in your browser, prevent your browsing history from being stored, and remove any tracking cookies (both first-party cookies and third-party cookies) or web cache you pick up during that browsing session.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Secure & Private Mode</strong> creates an encrypted tunnel between your device and the internet, encrypts your DNS queries, helps stop ads being shown in your browser, prevent your browsing history from being stored, and remove any tracking cookies (both first-party cookies and third-party cookies) or web cache you pick up during that browsing session.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>PIN Protection</strong> helps secure your device by locking access to the browser application on your device with a unique code. Your PIN Code is encrypted on device and is not stored on any servers.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Sync</strong> means you can sign into the browser using your Avast ID. Your browsing data (including bookmarks, history, settings, open tabs, passwords, address, phone numbers, and payment information) will be then backed up and available across all your devices. All backed-up data is encrypted.</li>
<li class="t-rtf-style--body3"><strong>Privacy Statistics</strong> are showing the users’ the advantage of our AdBlock and VPN through numbers, by presenting the number of ads blocked, number of malware blocked by our Web Shield, amount of browsing data protected by our VPN.</li>
</ul>
